race.comment: CONFUCIOUS FLYER (3) won both of his trials before finishing second here on debut a fortnight ago. He has a slightly better draw here, and with King Callow replacing an apprentice, he is set to go one better. GIFT OF SILENCE (9) was probably a run short with a month between runs when finishing fifth in the same race as the top pick. She will be spot on third up from a spell, and with only a fortnight since her last run, she can bounce straight back into the money. MADAM MONEYBAGS (11) was only beaten by a head when resuming at Gawler nearly 3 weeks ago off a tough draw. She gets a big swing in that department this time, and her first win is not far away. HANIATA (10) had a tough trip and still finished third on debut. Stick with him. EXPEEARE (4) was a bit flat last time out, and can make amends in this.
